transport.description: Message broker protocol to use for communication.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the message broker.

port.description: Port number of the message broker (STOMP default).

user.description: Username for authenticating to the message broker.

password.description: Password for authenticating to the message broker. Leave empty if not needed.

ssl.description: SSL/TLS settings for secure broker connection.

cert_reqs.description: Certificate verification mode: NONE, OPTIONAL, or REQUIRED.

loglevel.description: Verbosity level for logging: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) for each command execution.

pool_size.description: Maximum number of concurrent command workers.

retry_interval.description: Seconds to wait between retries on transient failures.

max_retries.description: Number of times to retry failed commands.

default_target.description: Default target pattern when none is specified (e.g., '*' = all hosts).

allowed_targets.description: List of allowed target patterns (regex or glob). If empty, all targets allowed.

modules.description: List of specific Cumin modules to load. Empty = auto-discover all.

command_whitelist.description: List of permitted commands (e.g., ['ping', 'uptime']). If empty, all commands allowed.

hooks.description: Shell commands to run before and after each execution.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging and disable throttling for troubleshooting.
